Many nations, such as India, seek to maintain strategic autonomy amid foreign military dependence. The case of Turkey highlights the risks associated with relying on specific suppliers. India aims to diversify its sources of military equipment while developing domestic manufacturing capabilities. Ultimately, operational independence hinges on managing maintenance and upgrades of advanced weapons systems.

Kumkum also won gold in the recurve team event and silver in the mixed team event. Her success has secured a quota place for India at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. She aims to achieve her ultimate goal of winning Olympic gold in the future.

title: Saudi-Pakistan defence pact: A big military promise, but little impact on the ground
description: The Pakistani government has refuted claims regarding its military involvement against Houthis in Yemen. This denial comes during intensified Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's oil infrastructure. Pakistan and Türkiye have not intervened in the ongoing conflict, despite treaty obligations to Saudi Arabia. Recent meetings between military leaders from these nations reaffirmed their commitment to Saudi security.

title: Top Trump official mocked online over false claim of Indian stock market crash after US green card curbs
French family found vase in attic; it later sold for $16.18 million
description: An 18th-century Chinese porcelain vase, forgotten in a French family's attic, sold for €16.18 million at Sotheby’s Paris in 2018. The family brought it to the auction house in a shoebox, unaware of its value. Experts identified it as a rare imperial vase made for the Qianlong Emperor, and it sold for over 23 times its estimated value.

title: ‘I was a daughter of Himachal’: Ritu’s heartbreak after state drops her from reward list
description: Ritu Negi, the celebrated captain of the kabaddi team, has been overlooked for a cash reward following the women's gold medal win at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. While her teammates received acknowledgments, her exclusion has raised serious concerns about recognition for athletes, especially after marriage. The Sports Minister has committed to reviewing this oversight and ensuring that Ritu's remarkable contributions are appropriately honored.

title: Dennis Quaid cuts asking price of remodeled LA home to $4.6m
description: Dennis Quaid has lowered the price of his Los Angeles mansion from $5.2 million to $4.6 million. He relocated to Nashville with his wife, Laura Savoie, and considers it their primary residence. After buying the Brentwood Hills property for $3.9 million in 2017, Quaid undertook extensive renovations. He expressed dissatisfaction with Los Angeles due to rising taxes and local governance issues.

title: Russell Peters bought Malibu estate for $4.725m, now asks $8.5m
description: Renowned comedian Russell Peters is making headlines again as he lists his stunning Malibu estate for sale at $8.5 million. After acquiring the property in 2014 for $4.725 million, he has transformed it with substantial renovations. This luxurious home, boasting six bedrooms, offers breathtaking ocean views and an inviting pool, perfect for entertaining.

description: In this case, the parents of two daughters and a son owned several properties. The daughters got married and moved to their husbands' homes. On September 10, 2026, the Madras High Court dismissed the sisters' appeal for a share, allowing their brother to retain the land.

description: CJP activist Abhijeet Dipke has challenged the heavy police presence and restrictions ahead of a planned protest. He claims that the protest will proceed despite not receiving official permission. Dipke has raised concerns about public inconvenience caused by transport shutdowns related to the protest. He emphasized the constitutional right to protest at designated sites like Jantar Mantar.

Trains arriving in Delhi between 4 am and 2 pm on October 10 are affected by these disruptions. The Mumbai Central-New Delhi Rajdhani Express and another service have been rescheduled by five hours due to anticipated traffic issues. Over 5,000 passengers from Western Railway and more than 1,200 from Central Railway were impacted.

description: Jeff Bezos and Leonardo DiCaprio have unveiled an ambitious initiative worth $200 million aimed at conserving endangered species globally. Named the Phoenix Species Project, this endeavor seeks to benefit 100 vulnerable species, offering vital funding and expertise to conservation organizations. Notable species targeted for attention include the charismatic Golden-crowned sifaka and the rare Visayan warty pig, addressing urgent biodiversity threats stemming from human activities and climate change.

title: 'My entire family will go': Kejriwal urges public to join October 10 protest
description: Arvind Kejriwal has called for a large-scale protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10. He accuses the BJP government and chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of systematic vote deletion. Despite police refusal for permission, the Cockroach Janata Party plans to proceed with their demonstration. Activists believe their constitutional right to protest should not require prior approval. Concerns regarding public inconvenience due to security measures have been raised by protest organizers.

title: 'Deeply offensive': Govt rebuts Vance’s indentured servants remark
Utah road plan would blast canyon cliffs; lawsuit says 47 historic sites at risk
description: Conservation organizations have launched a federal lawsuit against a proposed road paving initiative in Utah, citing risks to invaluable historic inscriptions and Native American rock art. Additionally, the project poses a threat to local wildlife, particularly the endangered Mexican spotted owl. The groups claim the US Bureau of Land Management bypassed essential evaluations, illuminating significant concerns surrounding environmental safeguarding and the preservation of cultural heritage.

title: CEC protests: INDIA bloc leaders to meet President Murmu today at 8pm
description: The INDIA bloc, a coalition of opposition parties, is gearing up for a significant meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. This meeting is pivotal as it aims to address issues related to the Election Commission's operations. Key leaders from various parties will assemble in Parliament before proceeding to the President's office.

Isabella Rossellini turned 27-acre New York farm into protected community farm
description: Mama Farm, founded by actress Isabella Rossellini in 2013, combines farming, animal care, and community activities. This Long Island property features a community-supported agriculture programme connecting members with locally produced food. The farm practices organic and regenerative techniques to preserve biodiversity while educating families about the environment. Various workshops and children's programs create opportunities for engagement with nature and agriculture.

title: 'Complete stoppage of metro, rail services unacceptable': SC to Centre ahead of CJP stir

However, the court observed that it could not consider easing the restrictions unless the denial of permission was challenged.

description: The ministry of external affairs reacted strongly to JD Vance's comments about H-1B visa workers. It stated that Indian professionals contribute significantly to the US economy and innovation landscape. The Ministry emphasized the history of immigrants shaping the US and condemned the terminology used by Vance. Furthermore, it noted the suspension of Permanent Labor Certification applications for several companies.

title: Delays of several hours: Passenger trains using slower freight locos amid shortage
description: Indian Railways records  contain several instances in which a lack of locomotives designed for passenger services led to trains being hauled by freight engines, which operate at lower speeds. The use of these locomotives has affected running times and caused operational delays, the records show. The Railway Ministry, however, said it was accelerating efforts to expand locomotive production.

President Donald Trump awarded these distinguished medals, recognizing their exceptional impact on technology and innovation, showcasing the profound influence these leaders have on the fabric of American society and its economy.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million Ohio estate faces dispute over $75,000 sewer bill
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion has sparked a growing dispute with neighbors over plans for a six-foot fence and extensive landscaping. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, security and potential damage to a century-old shared sewer pipe, with one neighbor citing a $75,000 repair estimate. Kelce’s construction team says it has made several compromises, but some landscaping proposals remain unresolved following recent planning board discussions.
